NIPC #74-228
Mr. Sigmund C. Ziejewski Regional Transportation Engineer Illinois Department of Transportation 300 North State Street Chicago, Illinois 60610
SUBJECT: NIPC Project No. 74-228 Illinois Department of Transportation -Funding for improvements to FAP Route 23 (Lincoln Highway) from Cicero Avenue to Chicago Road in Cook County.
ATTENTION: Mr. Richard Garrity
Dear Mr. Ziejewski:
This is to notify you that the above-referenced project has been reviewed by the Interstate Planning Committee in accordance with the procedures adopted jointly by this agency and the Northwestern Indiana Regional Planning Commission.
At a meeting held May 22, 1974, the Interstate Planning Committee concurred with the position taken by the Northeastern Illinois Planning Commission.
The attached letter should, therefore, be included as part of your final application to the appropriate federal or state agency, along with all other comments received through the Metropolitan Clearinghouse review.
If you have any questions in regard to this matter, please contact Mr. John Swanson, our Project Review Coordinator.
William S. Luhman
Assistant Director: Implementation
